# MF Arena

> Mutual fund portfolio tracker for India (Android). It reads the user's own CAMS or KFintech Consolidated Account Statement (CAS) and shows facts about their portfolio. It is read-only, does not execute transactions and is not investment advice.

## What it shows
- Portfolio value, amount invested, gain and XIRR (for the funds held, as investment platforms show it), updated with the latest NAV daily
- X-Ray: the stocks inside all the user's funds added together, and which funds hold the same stocks (overlap)
- Sectors and asset mix (stocks, bonds, gold, cash)
- Every transaction; yearly fund fees (expense ratio), Direct vs Regular, tax if sold today, comparison with a Nifty 50 index fund

## How it gets data
- Connect Gmail (read-only) to find CAS emails, or forward the CAS to a private import address
- Sign-in with a code sent to their email; no broker, bank or mutual fund passwords are ever asked for
